n: Architectural gold anodizing is the most color-stable anodized color.

n: The standard brick is about 3 3/4 × 2 1/4 × 8 in.

q: Which wood defect is lack of wood on an edge or corner?
n: Wane is missing wood or bark along an edge or corner.

n: High-strength alloy steel strands are used to prestress concrete.

n: Aluminum is attacked by alkalis, such as wet cement, and by hydrochloric acid.
